selected.assay: bulk 3' DGE mRNA-seq (UMI-deduplicated, Salmon 0.14.2 + tximport, Ensembl 98), scWAT, vWAT, triceps (SkM)
selected.sample_inclusion: 5 male C57BL/6N mice per group per tissue (S4.3.2.p1); 4 groups x 3 tissues = 60 libraries; same mice across tissues
selected.primary_estimand: Per tissue, effect of 3 weeks of voluntary wheel-running training on tissue gene expression: 'training' (train chow vs sed chow) and 'rescue' (train HFD vs sed HFD); 'obesity' (sed HFD vs sed chow) is the paper's third, diet-only comparison
planned_contrasts: training: train std vs sed std, per tissue (S2.2.p1, TAB1: scWAT 3, vWAT 47, SkM 92)
rescue: train HFD vs sed HFD, per tissue (S2.2.p1, TAB1: scWAT 132, vWAT 205, SkM 235)
obesity: sed HFD vs sed std, per tissue (S2.2.p1, TAB1: scWAT 492, vWAT 478, SkM 0)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none within a tissue (each tissue analysed separately; one library per mouse per tissue)
selected.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; per tissue keep genes with count > 10 in all samples (S4.4.1.1.p1)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 per tissue, IHW-adjusted p values, ashr-shrunk fold changes (S4.4.1.1.p1)
selected.paper_results: Table 1 (TAB1) DEG counts per tissue x comparison; Dbp, Tef, Nr1d2, Per3 up and Thbs1, Sparc down with training/rescue in WAT (S2.2.p2); Pdk4, Asb2 in SkM (S2.2.p2); Cdkn1a down by rescue in scWAT and vWAT (S2.2.p3)

decisions.reason: S4.1.3.p1 and TAB2 name GSE183239 as the bulk mRNA-seq; GSE183288 is the single-cell series and is not this case. S4.3.1.p1 describes the 2x2 diet x exercise design; S4.3.2.p1 says 5 mice per group were sequenced for the three tissues. S2.2.p1 defines the three pairwise comparisons; S4.4.1.1.p1 gives the per-tissue filter, DESeq2, IHW and ashr, and adjusted p < 0.05 with no fold-change rule. TAB1 gives the counts.

checks: paper S4.1.3.p1/TAB2 name GSE183239 for bulk mRNA-seq
60 GEO samples = 3 tissues x 4 groups x 5, matching S4.3.2.p1
data_processing matches S4.4.1.1.p1 (UMI dedup, Salmon 0.14.2, Ensembl 98, tximport)
series_id lists the SuperSeries GSE183290 named in the paper

decisions.reason: Accession, sample count, processing text and SuperSeries all match the paper.
